bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If Mek Tiknek is Engaged at the start of their Turn, gain +2 damage to melee attacks.

bonuses.name: Grot Oiler
bonuses.text: The Grot Oiler can be sacrificed to add +3 bonus dice to any Tech Test.

abilities.name: Mekanik
abilities.text: Mek Tiknek can repair any damaged piece of equipment within 1 metre. He can also Reload a weapon without spending an Action.

abilities.name: Orky Upgradez
abilities.text:
As a Free Action, Mek Tiknek may spend 1 Ruin to tinker with a ranged weapon within 1 metre. The weapon gains +1d3 ED and +1d3 AP for its next attack. The next time the weapon is fired, a Complication triggers if the Wrath Die lands on a 1, 2, or 3.

If the loyalty mission 'Yellow Wunz has more Dakka' has been completed, this is a normal Action instead of a Ruin Action.
